meta.title: Turn on Show Rank in a Price Based auction
gaps: Select an existing live auction specifically configured as Price Based when no event title or ID is provided
Verify the exact rank values and their precise adjacency to Best Price
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select an existing live auction specifically configured as Price Based when no event title or ID is provided; Verify the exact rank values and their precise adjacency to Best Price

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live bidding event from the buyer console.
Navigate to the Responses view where the Actions control and Best Price display are available.
Open the Actions menu containing the Show Rank control.
Toggle Show Rank on as required by the test.
Confirm the Best Price result remains visible after enabling rank display.
Confirm rank information is rendered in the responses view.
